**Tier 7.** Its `application`, `domain` and
`infrastructure` may import only a strictly lower tier. `http/` composes freely
but may never reach into another module's `http/` or `infrastructure/`.

May import: `account`, `activity`, `auth`, `catalog`, `chat`, `commerce`, `contact`, `customers`, `delivery`, `identity`, `invoicing`, `loyalty`, `messaging`, `payments`, `plugins`, `seo`, `settings`, `shipping`, `vintedReviews`, `vouchers`.

Currently imports: `catalog`, `commerce`, `messaging`, `plugins`, `settings`.
